title: Circuit-breaker remediation and staged upgrade scheduler for Private VPC health checks
creator: Aisha Ramos
description: This ticket defines an operational playbook and automated orchestrator (repair-worker + scheduler) that detects common Private VPC health check failures and executes non-invasive remediation steps with staged rollbacks and upgrade-safe circuit-breaker policies. Focus areas: Terraform drift-safe repairs, canary probe gating, immutable node tainting, KV-cache warmup, and metric-driven rollback.
runbook_steps: 1) Detect failure via VPC healthcheck alert (probe failure count > 3 within 5m).
2) Enrich alert: attach instance IDs, terraform resource addresses, last successful probe, recent terraform apply events.
3) Execute read-only diagnostic phase: gather system logs (journalctl), GPU health, kernel messages, container runtime status, and sflow/netflow snapshot.
4) If diagnostics show drift (terraform plan shows changes), create a drift-ticket and attempt terraform plan+apply in dry-run mode in staging first.
5) If drift is non-critical (tags/metadata mismatch), apply tag-only repair with safe-lock and no reboot; otherwise mark instance with 'taint=repair' and schedule replacement.
6) Circuit-breaker decision: based on error budget and regional capacity, either route traffic to fallback model variant or open circuit to stop new requests to affected nodes.
7) Repair worker actions: attempt rolling restart of affected service with backoff; if restart fails, perform immutable replacement with a new node from autoscaling group.
8) KV cache warmup: prefetch top-n prefixes from recent traffic into replacement node before it accepts traffic.
9) Post-repair validation: run synthetic transactions and probe endpoints for 3 consecutive successful checks across 60s.
10) If validation passes, untaint node and reintroduce to LB with canary percent at 5% then 25% then 100% over 10 minutes.
11) If validation fails, escalate to on-call SRE and trigger automatic rollback of any recent upgrade in the window (via deployment manager).
12) Close alert with full artifacts and create follow-up root-cause analysis ticket if incident exceeded SLO or required manual intervention.
playbook_summary: Implement an automated repair-worker that follows a diagnostics-first approach, prefers non-disruptive tag/metadata fixes, uses immutable replacement when necessary, and coordinates with a staged upgrade scheduler to avoid rolling upgrades during repair windows. Circuit-breaker policies prevent cascading failures and fallback to cheaper model variants when capacity constrained.
